about: Points for screener-v1 observations, applied by rerank.py --screened. The screener never scores. score_read = sum of these terms + the host re-rank's weakness terms (H5), which the screener does not observe. The computed proxies (H1-H4, H6) are left out of score_read because the screener reads what they guess at. Draft values from lessons-v1; NOT fitted. Do not tune them on the 9 calibration hosts (that would fit to the test set); refit after trial outcomes on newly screened hosts.

O1_entry_points._why: several entry points = scope failure room (hono, nltk)

O2_out_of_scope_site._why: a site that looks out of scope (pattern A's core lever)

O3_reason_to_dismiss._why: strongest single lever so far (jackson-sib DeepSeek 6/6)

O4_distance._why: distance from the landing point (marshmallow: no distance, solved)

O5_coupled_behaviour._why: over-broad fix breaks legitimate use (MiMo over-hardens)

O7_producer._why: producer is infrastructure off the check's path (Hadi; better-auth: handler does not count)

O11_fix_minutes._why: fairness: about 45 minutes for an engineer who knows where to look

O13_recall_risk._why: widely written-up fixes can be recalled
